# Noto Sans SC

Source: Google Fonts, Noto Sans SC v41, variable weights 300–700.

- Official project: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
- License source: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/notosanssc/OFL.txt
- CSS source: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@300..700&display=swap
- Retrieved: 2026-10-18

`fonts.css` contains local WOFF2 references and Unicode ranges. The browser downloads only matching chunks. The final face, `noto-sans-sc-ui.woff2`, is a Google Fonts text subset for current UI and content, reducing initial requests. Other characters automatically fall back to the complete local chunks. Editing content does not require regenerating fonts.

Do not remove the full chunks just because the current page uses the compact face; they cover future content. These files are self-hosted; visitors make no requests to Google Fonts. The SIL Open Font License is included as OFL.txt.
